about: The heroes' Deadlock ultimates as RoR2 equipment (Q). One row per equipment; its numbers, kind, sounds and effects are the skill row it names (skills slot equipment, cooldown 120). hero: who starts every run holding it. canDrop/enigmaCompatible/randomTrigger follow the Preon Accumulator (anyone can find it in chests, the Artifact of Enigma and Bottled Chaos can fire it). The pickup is a small figure of the hero; the HUD and logbook icon is the skill's Deadlock icon. figure: which part of the hero's model the pickup figure shows: all, or a material-name filter (rider: just Krill).

rows.pickupText: Spin and fire at every enemy nearby, evading attacks.
rows.lore: Haze never misses twice. The second shot is for the one who saw the first.

rows.pickupText: Leap, hover and crash down on the spot you pick, stunning everything there.
rows.lore: "Case closed." The crater was the only evidence left.

rows.pickupText: Call a storm where you stand: lightning strikes enemies inside, allies get a Warbanner.
rows.lore: The storm follows Seven the way a dog follows its master: loyal, loud, and dangerous to strangers.

rows.pickupText: Become a bomb: after 3s, explode, stunning everything nearby. Kills heal you.
rows.lore: Infernus doesn't run from fires. He is the fire.

rows.pickupText: Throw Krill: he leaps from enemy to enemy for 10s, then comes back.
rows.lore: Mo throws, Krill lands. Whatever Krill lands on stops moving for a while.
